defensible_alternative_candidates.note: Open-label awareness and post-progression care alone do not establish trial-context-caused deviations; the model Low remains plausible.
Different follow-up intervals over a composite endpoint are a plausible differential-monitoring mechanism; impact and rating remain unresolved.
Unmasked conduct and suspicion-triggered imaging are a candidate differential-opportunity mechanism; impact and rating remain unresolved.
Additional arm-specific laboratory checks support differential ascertainment; this does not establish a corrected label.
